inputs.row_universe: all point-in-time main-board candidates from the frozen learnability input; no future fill or label filter
inputs.base_feature_profile: 296 continuous plus 5 train-mapped categorical signal-close-or-earlier features

feature_catalog.layout: one feature-major float32 candidate-aligned file per family

common_rules.post_2025_rows: all newly generated feature values must remain NaN
common_rules.price_scale: all price-derived features are ratios, log distances, standardized values, or bounded states so a uniform back-adjustment scale cannot carry information
common_rules.missingness: retain causal missing values; LightGBM handles them natively; never backfill from a future bar
common_rules.reason_no_rank_expansion: new columns are already scale-free or normalized; avoid doubling family size and silently changing the tested concept

feature_family_semantics.recent_kline_sequence: lags 1 through 9 of eleven normalized OHLC, candle, amount-surprise, and relative-turnover channels plus the signal-day signed body; the signal-day baseline columns are not duplicated
feature_family_semantics.breakout_retest_levels: signal close/high/low distances to prior-window high and low, excluding the signal bar, plus level ages and the latest close breakout level, age, pullback distance, and breakout-day relative turnover for 20 and 60 day structures
feature_family_semantics.long_daily_context: the existing F1 return and seventeen rolling descriptors repeated only at new 120, 180, and 252 trading-day windows
feature_family_semantics.completed_week_month_context: return, moving-average distance, volatility, ATR, trend slope, and range position over 4/13/26/52 completed weeks and 3/6/12/24 completed months; the current partial calendar period is excluded
feature_family_semantics.traditional_indicators: KAMA(10,2,30), KAMA(20,2,30), MACD(12,26,9), KDJ(9,3,3), KDJ(21,3,3), and RSI(6/14/24) under deterministic causal recurrences
feature_family_semantics.confirmed_swing_structure: strict three-bar and five-bar local pivots exposed only after their right-side bars close, with pivot distance, age, change, density, swing position, and direction; this is a causal swing proxy and not a claim to implement a canonical subjective Chan-theory grammar
feature_family_semantics.turnover_cost_proxy: a daily typical-price cohort recursion weighted by recovered float turnover and surviving mass, reporting log cost distance, dispersion, normal-approximation profitable fraction, observed mass, and mean age; it is calculated from daily data and is not an exchange-provided chip distribution
feature_family_semantics.deterministic_hash_noise: 32 candidate-id keyed pseudo-random columns with the same firewall and missingness boundary; decision-invalidating negative control

protocol.fold_role: owner-authorized repeatedly reused recent decision folds; not a pristine holdout
protocol.primary_target: mfe_H highest legal entry-relative close opportunity excluding D1 under T+1
protocol.comparison: base features versus base plus exactly one family; no cumulative family union in this study
protocol.fold_rule: expanding history with horizon-specific label purge before each outer year

iteration_selection.source: baseline features only on the immediately preceding complete calendar year
iteration_selection.purge: same H-day dependency purge before the inner validation year
iteration_selection.refit: after selecting the tree count, refit every outer baseline and family variant on all purged history available before the outer year
iteration_selection.shared_capacity: all variants in the same horizon-year use the baseline-selected fixed tree count; the outer year never selects iterations

protocol.sample_weight: each signal date has equal total training weight; MFE-missing rows remain aligned with zero target weight

model.reason_full_feature_and_row_fraction: remove feature-subsampling and row-subsampling variance so the added family is the only structural difference

evaluation.overlap_control: Newey-West HAC on each paired daily delta with lag H-1
evaluation.cross_year_support: one-sided Stouffer combination of the three per-year HAC rank-IC tests, while year-level effect gates remain mandatory
evaluation.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over all 16 family/control by horizon hypotheses at frozen FDR q

family_status.core: both MFE D10 and D20 heads pass
family_status.specialized: exactly one head passes and the other head has no material IC or Top-5 mean harm
family_status.omit: no head passes or a nonpassing head has material harm

decision.negative_control_rule: if deterministic_hash_noise passes either horizon, invalidate the entire feature-family decision and retain no winner
decision.next_step: only non-omitted families may enter a new state10 incremental audit; state20 remains secondary and D3/D5 state remains reserved for post-entry path updating

scientific_firewall.owner_directive: continue using 2023-2025 as recent decision folds
